verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator only offers cloud backup/restore (docs-9, docs-13, docs-19) so a lost or new phone can recover accounts—this is a backup-and-restore model, not the always-in-sync, simultaneous multi-device experience (phone+tablet+computer) the story describes; there is no evidence of a desktop or tablet client at all. Community reports also describe a case where an app update wiped all account data and caused lockout (microsoft-authenticator-comm-1), undermining confidence that 'sync' is seamless and automatic. missing for 10: evidence of simultaneous multi-device (tablet/PC) token availability, real-time sync rather than manual backup/restore, and independent confirmation the backup process is reliable.
